title: Hunter Hunter
description: A fur trapper leaves his wife and daughter behind to kill a rogue wolf in the remote wilderness. But they soon become increasingly worried when a severely injured man shows up to disrupt their peaceful existence.

title: Random Acts of Violence
description: Comic book writers discover horrific events are related to a character they created.

title: The Reef
description: A sailing trip becomes a disaster for a group of friends when the boat sinks and a white shark hunts the helpless passengers.

title: Ruin Me
description: Alexandra reluctantly tags along for Slasher Sleepout, an extreme event that is part camping trip, part haunted house, and part escape room. But when the fun turns deadly, Alex has to play the game if she wants to make it out alive.

title: The Seed
description: What starts out as a weekend away in a remote luxury villa turns into a tale of horror, death and alien invasion.

title: The Marshes
description: Three young biologists fight to survive in a remote marshland when they encounter something evil.

title: Boar
description: In the beautiful, yet harsh Australian outback lives an animal of staggering size with a ferocious, driving need for blood and destruction. It defends its territory with savage force and kills with a raw, animalistic brutality not seen before.

title: The Babadook
description: A troubled widow (Essie Davis) discovers that her son is telling the truth about a monster that entered their home through the pages of a children's book.

title: I Am Not a Serial Killer
description: A troubled teen with homicidal tendencies has to hunt down and destroy a supernatural killer while suppressing his own inner demons.

title: Berberian Sound Studio
description: A sound engineer tortures people to get the sounds he needs for his work in an Italian horror studio.

title: The Djinn
description: A mute boy becomes trapped in his apartment with a sinister monster after making a wish to fulfill his heart's greatest desire.

title: Good Madam
description: The aftershocks of apartheid reverberate through a South African family as a daughter tries to free her mother from the grip of her mysterious employer.

title: Downrange
description: Some friends are attacked by a sniper after a tire blowout leaves them stranded.

S01 E06 — MOM (AND ALBERT)

title: Almost Human
description: Seth sees his best friend disappear in a flash of light. Two years later, Seth is still dealing with the fallout and suspicions when a series of grisly murders rocks the community.

title: Devil's Candy
description: A struggling painter is possessed by satanic forces after he and his family move into their dream home.

title: Color Out of Space
description: After a meteorite lands in the front yard of their farm, Nathan Gardner and his family find themselves battling a mutant extraterrestrial organism that infects their minds and bodies, transforming their quiet rural life into a technicolor nightmare.

title: A Banquet
description: A widowed mother is radically tested when her teenage daughter insists a supernatural experience has left her body in service to a higher power.

title: Allegoria
description: A timid actress, a tortured painter, a pretentious writer, a psychotic sculptor and a rock band all become entangled when their insecurities manifest themselves into monsters and ghouls.

title: Superdeep
description: In 1984 a Russian research team goes below the surface to find out what secret the world's deepest borehole is hiding. On their expedition, something unexpectedly gruesome awaits the researchers.

title: Prevenge
description: A pregnant woman kills an assortment of people.

title: The Ranger
description: A group of Punk-styled friends, fueled by a hallucinogenic drug called Echo, runs afoul of the law and an unhinged park ranger.

title: Vicious Fun
description: A horror film critic finds himself in a sticky situation when he stumbles into a self-help group for serial killers.

title: Skull: The Mask
description: A supernatural serial killer based on pre-Colombian mythology hunts for revenge in the metropolis of São Paulo.

title: Party Hard Die Young
description: A fun vacation quickly turns into a nightmare for a group of friends visiting Croatia.

title: Monster Party
description: Three thieves plan a daring heist at a mansion dinner party. When their plan goes horribly wrong, the thieves realize the dinner guests are not as innocent as they seem, and their simple cash grab becomes a violent and desperate battle to survive.

title: Saloum
description: Shot down after fleeing a coup and extracting a drug lord from Guinea-Bissau, a group of mercenaries must lie low at a remote holiday camp, stash their stolen haul, and repair their plane to escape back to Dakar, Senegal.

title: Mad God
description: A figure known as The Assassin descends from the heavens into a nightmarish pit full of monsters, titans and cruelty.

title: Sequence Break
description: A reclusive video arcade technician experiences bizarre biomechanical mutations and hallucinations when a mysterious new arcade machine appears in his shop.

title: Mandrake
description: Probation officer Cathy Madden is given the task of rehabilitating notorious killer "Bloody" Mary Laidlaw back into society after 20 years in jail. Cathy's beliefs are firmly tested when two children disappear near Mary's farm.

title: PG: Psycho Goreman
description: Intergalactic assassins converge on a small town after two siblings unwittingly resurrect an ancient alien overlord.

title: MadS
description: Romain sees an injured woman and decides to help her, but when she gets in his car, she suddenly smashes her own head against the dashboard, bleeding out until she dies.

title: Daddy's Head
description: A boy and his widowed stepmother find themselves in fear for their lives after they are visited by an unexplainable creature which appears to mimic the boy's recently deceased father.
